summary.summary: Deshay Ramos called Arizona Roofers requesting a roof inspection and inspection report for a property at 159 East Pebble Trow, Casa Grande, AZ 85122, as the home is being prepared to go on the market and they want to address any potential age-related roof repairs. Bronte explained that inspection reports differ from standard repair estimates and confirmed there are no known current roof issues. Deshay identified as the agent for the property, noted the home is in an HOA, confirmed there are no solar panels, and said there are no special access needs (tech can just come by). Deshay agreed to be the main point of contact and will review the proposal with the owner, Ted. The appointment was scheduled for Monday, 2026-01-19 in the 1:00–3:00 PM window, with Deshay indicating they will be present for liability requirements and will notify the company if anything changes; the rep will send SMS confirmation and the technician will contact about 30 minutes before arrival.
key_points: Caller Deshay Ramos is the agent for the property (owner is Ted) and requested a roof inspection/inspection report to prepare the home for market; no known current roof issues, concern is age-related.
